For strain rates below 10-2 s-1, the peak stress is relatively sensitive to the strain rate, and m is estimated to be approximately 0.12.
the peak stress of MHC at 1400°C also has a weak sensitivity to the strain rate, and m was approximately 0.07, which is slightly larger than that of the 70Mo alloy at 1400°C.

As the strain-rate sensitivity of the 70Mo alloy is close to that of MHC, one dominant deformation mechanism in the 70Mo alloy may be the dislocation bypass mechanism between precipitates in the Moss.
